jobs.title: Internship/ ASSISTANT(E) CATEGORY MANAGER ENSEIGNES GMS & CIRCUIT SELECTIF
jobs.description:
ASSISTANT(E) CATEGORY MANAGER ENSEIGNES GMS & CIRCUIT SELECTIF
6 months starting from January 2027

DESCRIPTION DE L'ENTREPRISE

Coty est un leader mondial de la beauté, avec près de 9 milliards de dollars de recettes, son but est de célébrer et libérer la beauté des consommateurs dans sa diversité. Avec son solide héritage entrepreneurial, Coty a créé un portefeuille iconique de marques leaders de la beauté. Coty est leader mondial du parfum, numéro 3 du maquillage.

Coty possède 2 divisions : Coty Consumer Beauty, qui regroupe le maquillage, les soins du corps, et les parfums vendus en grandes surfaces avec des marques telles que Bourjois, Rimmel, Sally Hansen et Adidas ; et Coty Luxury qui est centré sur des soins et parfums de marques Prestige comme Chloé, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Calvin Klein et Philosophy.
Coty et ses marques s’engagent dans un large éventail de causes sociales et environnementales.

VOS MISSIONS

Pour ce stage, vous faites partie intégrante de l'équipe Commerciale au sein de la division Consumer Beauty et vous assisterez le Category Manager Enseignes sur ses enseignes GMS & circuit séléctif sur les catégories Maquillage et Hygiène Parfumerie :

Analyse et pilotage des leviers catégoriels des enseignes dans le but de développer l’ensemble des produits de la catégorie et les marques de l’entreprise :

-
Analyse des performances des opérations promotionnelles et des supports trade marketing déployés pour les clients

-
Participation aux différentes analyses de marché (Sell In, Sell Out, Taux de destruction, promotion, DN, Drive) et collaborer sur les différentes créations d'outils du Category Manager

-
Exploitation du panel de distributeurs IRI afin de développer une connaissance approfondie des catégories Maquillage & Hygiène parfumerie et identifier les tendances et opportunités

-
Gestion de l’ensemble de la promotion nationale et régionale (développement d’outils de communication pour les magasins et la force de vente).

-
Participation à la mise en place des salons enseigne.

VOUS ÊTES UN "COTY FIT

-
Etudiant(e) en recherche de stage de césure ou de stage fin d’études

-
Vous êtes sensible au secteur de l’hygiène-parfumerie et de la cosmétique.

-
Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se), autonome et vous avez le sens du service et une grande aisance relationnelle.

-
Vous savez prioriser et jongler entre différents dossiers et avez un esprit analytique.

-
Vous êtes doté(e) d'un fort esprit analytique (bon niveau en Excel requis) et d'une sensibilité créatrice.

AVANTAGES

- Tickets-restaurants / accès au restaurant d’entreprise

- Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transports.

- Accès à la boutique COTY avec des tarifs préférentiels sur les produits COTY

- Accès à la salle de sport et aux cours collectifs.

LOCALISATION : Paris 17ème, au siège de COTY FRANCE

DUREE ET DATE DE DEBUT : Stage de 6 mois partir de Janvier 2027

A PROPOS DE COTY

Coty est l'une des plus grandes entreprises de beauté au monde, avec un portefeuille de marques emblématiques dans les domaines de la parfumerie, de la cosmétique, des soins de la peau et des soins du corps. Chez Coty, nous célébrons l'ensemble du kaléidoscope humain et cultivons une culture de la gentillesse sans peur. C'est pourquoi nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur respectueux de l'égalité des chances. Nous ne discriminons aucun candidat ou employé et nous nous efforçons d'être un lieu de travail ouvert, inclusif et diversifié où tous les employés peuvent se montrer sous leur vrai jour.

Pour plus d’informations sur Coty Inc., veuillez consulter le site www.coty.com/your-career

jobs.title: HR Director DACH (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
HR Director DACH (m/w/d)

We are Coty, a leading global cosmetics company. As a fragrance provider, we are the global market leader and number three in make-up. Our comprehensive portfolio, comprising countless renowned brands, is sold in over 150 countries. We believe in beauty with a progressive vision and in brands that inspire our customers – wherever they are in the world.

Successful brands in the luxury and lifestyle sectors form part of our local portfolio. Our colleagues (m/f/d) at HUGO BOSS, CALVIN KLEIN, GUCCI, BURBERRY, CHLOÉ and many more are looking forward to welcoming you!

Look forward to:

- Work smart – up to 50% remote working, trust-based working hours and flexible working arrangements

- Team – A positive working atmosphere and culture, characterised by diversity, collaboration and fun

- International environment – Working in an international workplace and corporate environment with flat hierarchies and exciting projects

- Working environment – Modern workplace design and a new office!

- Parking & transport links – Free company car parks, a central location and good links to public transport

Role Purpose
The HR Director, DACH is a strategic member of the regional leadership team, responsible for shaping the organizational capabilities, leadership, talent and culture required to deliver Coty's business ambitions across 2 Business Units (Prestige & Consumer) and 3 countries: Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Operating in a dynamic and evolving consumer beauty environment, the role leads the people agenda across approximately 500 employees, partnering closely with business leaders to accelerate organizational change and effectiveness, workforce agility and sustainable business performance.
The HR Director translates business priorities into impactful people strategies, ensuring Coty has the organizational structure, leadership and talent required to adapt, grow and compete in a rapidly changing market. Through change management, the role helps shape the future of the DACH organization and directly contributes to business success.
Leading a lean HR team of five, this leader operates from boardroom to shop floor, co-creating solutions with leaders and employees, driving organizational change, building new capabilities, and fostering an engaged, agile and high-performing workforce that delivers sustainable business results. The role also ensures a pragmatic and compliant approach to employee and labour relations, maintaining constructive relationships with employee representatives and safeguarding Coty's licence to operate across the region.

Scope & Dimensions
• Geographic remit: Germany, Austria and Switzerland across three legal and labour-law jurisdictions.
• Employee population / HR team: Approximately 500 employees; leadership of five HR professionals.
• Business environment: Dynamic, matrixed consumer beauty organization undergoing continuous transformation and evolution.
• Stakeholders: Regional and functional leadership teams, Centres of Excellence, HR Services, Reward, employees and employee representative bodies across DACH.
• Remit: Organizational change & effectiveness, HR business partnership, talent, culture, leadership, employee engagement, HR operations, governance, compliance and employee relations.

Key Accountabilities

Stake holder Co-Creation & Collaboration
• Co-create people solutions with business leaders, functional partners, CoEs and employee representatives.
• Operate with agility, pace and pragmatism in a fast-moving, matrixed beauty business.
• Translate complex topics into simple, compelling narratives for audiences from works council to executive committee.
• Build trust-based relationships through visible presence and close proximity to the business and its people.

Business Transformation & Change Management
• Serve as HR architect and driver of major transformation, reorganization and change programmes across DACH.
• Lead the people workstream end-to-end — OD, workforce planning, consultation, transition and cultural change.
• Build change strategies that engage leaders and employees, sustain momentum and embed new ways of working.
• Convert operating-model, footprint and productivity strategy into executable people plans with measurable outcomes.

HR Business Partnering, Talent & Operations
• Own the DACH people strategy, using data to inform workforce, cost, productivity and people-risk decisions.
• Drive talent, DE&I, engagement, culture and leadership effectiveness.
• Ensure compliant HR operations across the three countries with HR Services, CoEs and Reward.
• Safeguard data privacy, health & safety and governance.
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing HR team of five.

Employee & Labour Relations (DACH)
• Act as Coty’s most senior ER/LR authority in DACH, personally leading complex, sensitive and high-stakes employee and labour relations matters.
• Lead relationships and negotiations with works councils, trade unions and social partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland — negotiating works agreements, reconciliation of interests and social plans as required.
• Ensure full compliance with German, Austrian and Swiss labour law, co-determination and collective bargaining frameworks; anticipate legislative change.
• Advise and coach leaders on disciplinary, grievance, restructuring, transfer and exit processes — balancing commercial objectives with legal risk and Coty’s values.
• Manage labour litigation and external counsel; minimise labour-relations risk and reputational exposure.

The ideal Coty Fit:

Skills
• Language: fluent German (native or full professional proficiency) and fluent English — non-negotiable.
• Transformation & change: proven, track record of leading or participating in business transformation and change programmes (restructuring, reorganization, integration and cultural change) to sustained results.
• Stakeholder co-creation: strong record of co-creation and collaboration, with the agility to work at pace and the articulation to influence at all levels; a visible, business-close leadership style.
• Leadership: experience leading and developing HR teams; comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on within a lean structure.
• Commercial acumen: understands the business drivers behind performance, brings both an internal and external market lens, and makes pragmatic decisions that support business outcomes while managing risk.
• ER / LR depth: demonstrable expertise across DACH — hands-on with German co-determination, works councils, collective bargaining; Austrian and Swiss labour law and employee representation will be a plus

Experience
• At least 15 years of HR experience, including the last 5 years in a leadership position in the DACH region.
• Experience in Coty-adjacent industries such as B2C, beauty, consumer products, retail or other fast-paced consumer-facing environments is highly valued.
• International experience would be a plus.

Qualifications
• Degree in HR, Law, Business, Psychology or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

How to apply:

Have we sparked your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your full application, stating your earliest possible start date and your salary expectations.

Your direct point of contact for this role is Christopher Johnson.

ABOUT US

Coty is one of the world’s largest cosmetics companies and boasts a renowned portfolio of brands in fragrance, make-up, and skincare and body care. Coty is the world’s leading supplier of perfumes and ranks third in the make-up sector, distributing products in over 150 countries worldwide. Coty and its brands are also committed to a range of social initiatives and strive to minimise their environmental impact.

For further information about Coty Inc., please visit our website at www.coty.com/ .

At Coty, we value diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of skin colour, ethnicity, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status or disability. jobs.title: Road Transport Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
ROAD TRANSPORT TRANSFORMATION MANAGER

SUPPLY CHAIN / GLOBAL TRANSPORT

The Road Transport Transformation Manager is a global strategic role focused on shaping the future of Coty's road transport network. Rather than managing daily transport operations, you will drive large-scale improvements that make our network more efficient, resilient, sustainable and digitally enabled. Through transformation initiatives, network optimization and innovation, you will help create the transport capabilities needed to support Coty's future growth.

THE ROLE

OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE!

As our Road Transport Transformation Manager , you will lead strategic initiatives that transform how road transport is managed across Coty. You will drive performance improvements, strengthen transport capabilities, accelerate digitalization and sustainability, and support the transition towards a more standardized, data-driven and future-ready transport organization.

You will be reporting to the Global Transport Operations Director , and you will manage:

Transport Transformation & Performance

- Lead global initiatives that improve transport cost, service, efficiency and sustainability.

- Establish performance frameworks, KPIs and governance that enable data-driven decision making.

- Develop business cases, action plans and recommendations, presenting outcomes and progress to senior leadership.

- Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardize and optimize road transport processes.

Network Design & Future Capabilities

- Design and optimize road transport networks to improve resilience, scalability and long-term capacity.

- Develop new capabilities and operating models aligned with Coty's supply chain strategy, including DTC and intermodal solutions.

- Drive transport sustainability initiatives, including decarbonization, alternative fuels and modal shift opportunities.

- Improve customer service and cost-to-serve through smarter transport network design and collaboration.

Digitalization & Strategic Partnerships

- Lead transport transformation projects from concept through implementation.

- Partner with IT and the Transport Community of Practice to deploy digital, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

- Strengthen carrier and logistics service provider management through standardized processes and governance.

- Support strategic sourcing initiatives, RFQs and supplier selection decisions to secure the best long-term transport solutions.

YOU ARE A COTY FIT

As a strategic, analytical and digitally minded transport professional , you thrive in a fast-paced and international environment. You are proactive, structured and comfortable leading projects across multiple stakeholders and functions.

- University degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Engineering, Transport or a related field.

- 5-8 years of experience in road transport, ideally within a multinational company, logistics provider or transport organization.

- Good understanding of road transport operations and industry best practices.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.

- Skilled in working with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)

- Proficiency in working with Power BI

- Interest or experience in AI, automation, data visualization and digital process improvement.

- Experience leading projects and influencing stakeholders in a matrix environment.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

At Coty, we value data savvy people. As part of the Coty curated strategic program, we are transforming into a data centric organization powered by AI. If you have data engineering skills or experience developing dashboards in Power BI, this is considered a strong advantage.

If you’re ready to support and shape the future of beauty, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE OFFER

This is a unique role with a genuine opportunity to make an impact. You'll get to work in a diverse environment with a team of professionals who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way.

Coty's global omni-working policy provides the option to work up to 50% of your month remotely. We believe that a more flexible philosophy of remote working will give everyone the freedom to choose what works for their individual circumstances and empower them to always perform at their best.

ABOUT US

Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you're the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible – we'd love to hear from you.

Coty is deeply committed to Changing the Conversation around Diversity, Equity & Inclusion to create a more open, inclusive, and diverse workplace where all employees can be their authentic self.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
SENIOR FINANCIAL PLANNING & ANALYSIS (FP&A) MANAGER

FINANCE / FP&A
DACH

As our Senior FP&A Manager, you will act as a strategic finance partner to the DACH leadership team, driving financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and business decision-making across the entire DACH P&L.

THE ROLE

OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE!

As our Senior FP&A Manager , you play a critical role in leading the financial planning and forecasting agenda for DACH. You will partner closely with the GM, CFO, and cross-functional leadership teams, delivering financial insights, driving forecasting accuracy, and ensuring robust financial control to support the achievement of business objectives.

You will be reporting to the CFO DACH , and you will manage:

1. Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

- Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles across the full DACH P&L

- Drive variance analysis and forecasting processes in collaboration with cross-functional teams

- Own the local finance calendar and ensure timely delivery of planning milestones

- Manage financial inputs into planning tools, including Hyperion

- Ensure clear reconciliation versus prior year, previous forecasts, and business plans

2. S&OP & Commercial Performance Support

- Actively participate in the S&OP planning process and provide financial guidance on risks and opportunities

- Partner with Supply Chain and Category Growth teams to improve forecast accuracy

- Translate operational and sales plans into divisional and DACH-level financial forecasts

- Support decision-making through meaningful financial analysis and business insights

3. Month-End Close & Reporting

- Coordinate month-end close activities across the local Commercial Finance team

- Serve as key contact for regional Finance and Accounting teams

- Lead monthly actual-versus-forecast reviews and variance analyses

- Prepare and communicate financial reporting for senior leadership

- Support Monthly Business Updates and Business Reviews with financial insights and recommendations

4. Financial Analysis & Business Partnering

- Conduct profitability analyses for brands, product lines, and strategic initiatives

- Support Marketing teams with business cases, investment proposals, and P&L simulations

- Evaluate product launches, promotions, and commercial initiatives through ROI and profitability assessments

- Contribute to the development of financial processes supporting new business models and channels (e.g., TikTok Shop)

5. Leadership, Collaboration & Process Excellence

- Act as an active member of the regional FP&A network to drive process improvements and best practices

- Facilitate effective communication between local and regional stakeholders

- Drive alignment across Finance, Commercial, Marketing, Supply Chain, and senior leadership teams

- Promote planning efficiency, governance, and analytical excellence across the DACH organization

YOU ARE A COTY FIT

As a strategic finance professional, you enjoy translating complex business and financial data into actionable insights that drive growth and performance.

Your skills and experience include:

- Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Sales Controlling, Brand Controlling, or related Finance functions

- Strong understanding of P&L management, balance sheet dynamics, and US GAAP principles

- Excellent experience with forecasting, variance analysis, and performance management

- Strong business acumen and understanding of commercial performance drivers

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance or Accounting

- Advanced Excel skills; SAP, SAP HANA, and Hyperion experience are advantageous

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills

- Fluent English and ability to operate within an international environment

If you’re ready to influence strategic decisions and shape financial performance across DACH, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE OFFER

This role offers a highly visible position at the heart of the DACH business, with extensive exposure to commercial and senior leadership teams.

- Strategic partnership with the GM, CFO, and leadership team

- Broad exposure to end-to-end P&L management and business performance

- Opportunity to influence forecasting, planning, and transformation initiatives

- International and collaborative working environment

- Hybrid working model and strong development opportunities

ABOUT US

Our people make us who we are. At Coty, we celebrate diversity, fearless kindness, and bold thinking—creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can be their authentic self.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
CUSTOMER MARKETING MANAGER – COLOR BRANDS

CUSTOMER MARKETING / TRADE MARKETING
Poland

As our Customer Marketing Manager – Color Brands, you will drive the promotional strategy and commercial activation plans for Coty’s Color portfolio, partnering closely with Sales and key customers to accelerate growth, maximize ROI, and strengthen market performance.

You will lead promotional planning, monitor performance, manage budgets, and develop data‑driven recommendations that support sustainable growth across key retail and e‑commerce channels.

- Strong planning, organizational, and prioritization skills.

- Advanced MS Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

- Passion for the beauty industry is a plus.

If you’re ready to shape the future of Coty’s Color brands and drive customer growth through impactful activation strategies, we want you on our team!

This role offers strong visibility across both customer and brand organizations, with the opportunity to influence key commercial decisions.

- Opportunity to build your career within a dynamic and growing international company.

- Hybrid working model.

- Attractive benefits package.

- Collaborative and supportive working environment.

- Exposure to globally recognized beauty brands and international stakeholders.

ABOUT US

Our people make us who we are. At Coty, we celebrate diversity, fearless kindness, and bold thinking—creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can be their authentic self while helping shape the future of beauty.

jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager, Social Media & Content - Global CoverGirl and Sally Hansen

Global Marketing – New York, NY

FINANCE / BRAND FINANCE & COMMERCIAL FINANCE
DACH & EUROPE

As our Senior Brands Finance Manager, you will act as the key Finance Business Partner to the DACH Brand teams while supporting the development of stronger Brand Finance capabilities across Europe. You will drive profitable growth through financial insight, performance management, strong governance, and strategic decision support.

THE ROLE

OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE!

As our Senior Brands Finance Manager , you play a critical role in supporting brand growth, investment decisions, and profitability across DACH while contributing to selected European Finance initiatives. You will combine strategic business partnering with strong financial governance, helping Marketing and Commercial teams make data-driven decisions that maximize value creation.

You will report to the Commercial Finance Director Europe and partner closely with DACH Finance leadership.

1. Brand Finance & Business Partnership

- Act as Finance Business Partner to DACH Brand teams, supporting growth and profitability decisions.

- Provide financial guidance on investment priorities and brand performance.

- Partner with Marketing and Commercial stakeholders to ensure financially sound decision-making.

- Build strong relationships across Finance, Commercial, and Marketing communities.

2. Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

- Prepare and challenge Brand P&Ls, Gate P&Ls, pricing assumptions, and ROI analyses.

- Own A&CP forecasting, tracking, and governance across Outlook, Profit Forecast, Annual Plan, and Strategic Planning cycles.

- Deliver variance analysis, risk and opportunity assessments, and gap-closing recommendations.

- Lead Annual Planning governance and coordinate stakeholder inputs across the business.

3. Pricing, Investment & Profitability

- Support pricing initiatives through financial impact assessments and performance tracking.

- Evaluate investment effectiveness and return on investment for marketing activities.

- Drive profitability improvements through fact-based recommendations.

- Ensure commercial decisions remain aligned with long-term business objectives.

4. Governance, Controls & Compliance

- Maintain strong governance standards across A&CP investments.

- Ensure compliance with SOX requirements and audit standards.

- Support audit documentation and external licensor audit requests.

- Drive financial discipline and transparency across the DACH brand portfolio.

5. European Brand Finance Initiatives

- Support selected European Brand Finance projects focused on consistency and transparency.

- Improve reporting quality, investment governance, and decision support across European markets.

- Develop harmonized templates, tools, and processes across markets.

- Drive improvements in A&CP visibility, ROI analysis, forecasting, and performance management.

YOU ARE A COTY FIT

As a commercially minded finance professional, you thrive in a business-partnering environment and enjoy influencing strategic decisions through strong financial insight.

Your skills and experience include:

- Strong Commercial Finance experience, ideally within Beauty, FMCG, or branded consumer businesses.

- Deep understanding of P&L management, A&CP, forecasting, planning, pricing, and ROI analysis.

- Proven ability to challenge senior Marketing and Commercial stakeholders constructively.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into business recommendations.

- Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills.

- Collaborative approach and interest in driving best-practice sharing across European markets.

- Advanced financial modelling skills.

- Experience with Power BI, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled finance solutions is considered an advantage.

- Comfortable operating in a matrix organization with both local and regional responsibilities.

If you’re ready to influence brand investment decisions and shape the future of Brand Finance across DACH and Europe, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE OFFER

This role offers a unique combination of local ownership and European strategic exposure.

- Opportunity to act as the lead Brand Finance partner for the DACH business.

- Exposure to European Finance leadership and cross-market initiatives.

- Strong visibility across Commercial, Marketing, and Finance leadership teams.

- Opportunity to shape finance transformation, automation, and AI adoption in Brand Finance.

This role drives brand transformation, portfolio performance, consumer engagement and organisational effectiveness across iconic beauty brands, whilst building a future-fit, high-performing marketing organisation that delivers sustainable business results.

THE ROLE

OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE!

As our Senior Marketing Director, Colour Cosmetics & Mass Fragrance UKI , you play a critical role in shaping portfolio strategy, accelerating brand growth, driving commercial performance and transforming marketing capability across some of the UK’s most recognisable beauty brands. You will lead cross-functional collaboration, consumer-centric innovation and organisational excellence to deliver sustainable growth and market leadership.

You will manage some key areas

Portfolio Leadership & Commercial Growth

- Lead the strategic direction and growth agenda for the Colour Cosmetics and Mass Fragrance portfolio, including Rimmel, Max Factor and Sally Hansen.

- Develop and execute long-term portfolio strategies that drive revenue, profitability, market share and brand equity.

- Define and deliver transformational growth plans, including the roadmap to return Rimmel to sustainable growth.

- Drive the successful execution of Max Factor’s brand positioning to strengthen consumer relevance and engagement.

- Ensure resources and investment are prioritised towards the highest-value commercial opportunities.

Marketing Strategy & Consumer Engagement

- Lead integrated, insight-driven marketing strategies across all portfolio brands.

- Oversee media investment, campaign performance and advocacy strategies to maximise business impact.

- Evolve influencer, advocacy and digital engagement approaches to connect with younger and future consumers.

- Ensure excellence in activation across consumer, retailer and omni-channel touchpoints.

- Champion consumer, shopper and market insights to drive strategic decisions and innovation.

Leadership, Capability & Strategic Partnership

- Build and develop a future-ready, high-performing marketing organisation.

- Lead succession planning, capability development and organisational design initiatives.

- Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

- Partner with senior leaders across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Merchandising and Global Marketing functions.

- Influence strategic decision-making and represent marketing at leadership forums and business reviews.

YOU ARE A COTY FIT

As a strategic and commercially driven marketing leader , you thrive in a fast-paced and diverse environment. You are consumer-obsessed, highly collaborative, resilient and passionate about building brands, developing talent and delivering transformational growth.

- Significant senior marketing leadership experience within Beauty, FMCG or Consumer Goods

- Proven track record of delivering sustainable brand and category growth

- Extensive experience managing complex portfolios with full P&L accountability

- Strong strategic planning, commercial and analytical capabilities

- Experience leading large-scale organisational change and transformation

- Proven ability to build, coach and develop high-performing teams

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills within matrix organisations

- Deep understanding of UK retail, shopper and consumer dynamics, ideally across colour cosmetics and fragrance

If you're ready to support and shape the future of beauty, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE OFFER

At Coty, we believe in performance-driven growth - we have a strong track record of accelerating careers, with individuals progressing from an entry level role in Senior Director in under 10 years, and high performers achieving rapid progression through the organisation.

You will also have great benefits package including amongst others, the following:

- A competitive benefits package to support your health, wellbeing and financial security

- Private medical insurance with fast access to specialist and mental health support

- 8% pension fully contributed by Coty

- Life assurance and income protection for added peace of mind

- Flexible hybrid working with our Omni-Working model (up to 50% remote)

- Generous family-friendly policies including enhanced parental leave, birthday leave and volunteering days

- Everyday perks including employee discounts and salary sacrifice schemes

- Opportunities to get involved in DE&I, sustainability and employee-led initiatives

ABOUT US

Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you're the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible – we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: HR Operations Intern
jobs.description:
HR Operations Intern -Iberia-

We are looking for an HR Operations Specialist to join our Iberia HR Operations team.  In this role, you will learn about how multinational HR Operations department works. You will expand your knowledge of HR and will be able to participate in a transformation journey.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As our HR Operations Intern, you will support the team in delivering a best-in-class employee experience and full compliance across the employee lifecycle (hiring, data changes and terminations). You will gain practical exposure to HR administration, employee onboarding, HR systems, HR processes, reporting and continuous improvement, working closely with HR Operations Specialists, Payroll, HR Business Partners and external providers. The role mainly supports Spain and may also provide assistance with Portugal.

Your main focus:

Personnel Administration

-
Support the preparation and review of documentation for new hires, contract extensions, employee data changes and terminations.

-
Help maintain accurate employee data and documentation in HR systems and internal trackers.

-
Assist with the filing, organization and quality control of employment documentation, following confidentiality and compliance requirements.

-
Support the team with administrative follow-up related to sick leave, absences, permits and other employee lifecycle processes.

-
Learn to manage the official platforms SILTRA (Social Security communications), SEPE (contracts, leaves, terminations) and Delt@/CAT365 (workplace accidents).

Labor Relations

-
Learn about leaves (maternity, paternity, pregnancy, permits and licenses).

-
Learn about severance calculations and exit documentation.

-
Learn about calendars, holidays and working hours; prepare letters about changes in conditions (e.g., BA schedules).

-
Prepare letters, certificates and documentation requested by employees (e.g., for schools).

Employee Onboarding & Support

-
Contact new joiners to request and follow up on the documentation required for onboarding.

-
Onboarding employees: contract, Tax Model 145, Tax Regime, Time & Attendance, Flexible Compensation, medical insurance and other benefits enrollment.

-
Inform and support employees on benefits, T&A and leaves.

-
Contact with HR providers, solve issues escalating when necessary, improve processes and the quality of the service.

-
Possibly manage Purchase Orders in SAP, providers transfers and invoices.

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

-
Perform data checks and help identify missing, inconsistent or outdated information.

-
Support the monitoring of HR requests and follow-up actions to help ensure timely service delivery.

-
Prepare and update recurring HR reports, trackers and presentations using Excel and Microsoft Office.

-
Participate in process improvement, digitalization and HR transformation initiatives.

YOU ARE A COTY FIT

You are curious, organized, service-oriented and eager to learn. You enjoy working as part of a team, pay attention to detail and are motivated by an international and fast-paced environment.

-
Currently studying a university degree or master’s programme in Human Resources or Labour Relations.

-
Able to enter into an internship agreement with a university or business school.

-
Interest in HR Operations, personnel administration, labour relations and employee services.

-
Fluency in Spanish and a good level of English, both written and spoken.

-
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel; interest in learning HR systems and digital tools.

-
Accurate, discreet and responsible when handling confidential employee information.

-
Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

-
Proactive, collaborative and comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback.

WHAT WE OFFER

-
A hands-on learning experience in a multinational HR Operations environment.

-
Exposure to the full employee lifecycle and to HR processes, systems and transformation projects.

-
Guidance and continuous support from an experienced HR Operations team.

-
An internship agreement and allowance in line with company policy.

-
Flexible schedule and hybrid remote and office-based work, subject to the internship and business requirements.

-
An inclusive, collaborative and international working environment in our Barcelona office.

ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, colour cosmetics, skincare, and body care. At Coty, we celebrate the entire human kaleidoscope and cultivate a culture of fearless kindness. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We do not discriminate against any candidate or employee and strive to be an open, inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees can be their authentic self. Join us in making over the world of beauty!
